import bpy
ns=bpy.app.driver_namespace['shipyard_craft']
exec(r'''
def remap_timber(ob,role):
 row={'frame':0,'cargo_frame':1,'trim':2,'deck':3}[role];vs=ob.data.vertices
 lo=Vector([min(v.co[i] for v in vs) for i in range(3)]);hi=Vector([max(v.co[i] for v in vs) for i in range(3)]);span=hi-lo;L=span.x
 uv=ob.data.uv_layers.active;shift=(22-L)*(sum(map(ord,ob.name))%97)/97
 ob.data.update()
 for p in ob.data.polygons:
  ax=max(range(3),key=lambda i:abs(p.normal[i]))
  for li in p.loop_indices:
   q=vs[ob.data.loops[li].vertex_index].co-lo
   if ax==0:u=(3844+q.y/.36*247)/4096;v=(row*256+4+q.z/.36*247)/1024
   else:u=(4+(q.x+shift)/22*3831)/4096;v=(row*256+4+q[1 if ax==2 else 2]/.36*247)/1024
   uv.data[li].uv=(u,v)
for which in ['A','B']:
 c=bpy.data.collections['Shipyard_'+which+'_Craft']
 for ob in c.objects:
  if ob.type!='MESH' or not ob.data.materials:continue
  name=ob.name
  iscrate=any(s in name for s in ['tool chest','parts crate','inside spare','workshop spares'])
  issign='signboard' in name
  iscabin='cabin back' in name or 'cabin side lower' in name
  if (iscrate and (' face' in name or ' side' in name)) or issign or iscabin:
   sy=max(v.co.y for v in ob.data.vertices)-min(v.co.y for v in ob.data.vertices);sz=max(v.co.z for v in ob.data.vertices)-min(v.co.z for v in ob.data.vertices)
   for v in ob.data.vertices:v.co.y*=sz/sy;v.co.z*=sy/sz
   remap_timber(ob,'deck' if issign or iscabin else 'cargo_frame')
  if name.startswith('B') and any(s in name for s in ['facade plank','upper facade end','gable plank','rear plank','sliding leaf']) and 'diagonal' not in name:
   ob.rotation_mode='QUATERNION';ob.rotation_quaternion=Matrix(((0,1,0),(0,0,1),(1,0,0))).to_quaternion()
 import bmesh
 for ob in c.objects:
  if 'old roof sheet' in ob.name:
   bm=bmesh.new();bm.from_mesh(ob.data);bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm,faces=list(bm.faces));bm.to_mesh(ob.data);bm.free()
 # Physically map rounded spars and handles to the long-wood region, never tile an atlas.
 for ob in c.objects:
  if ob.type!='MESH' or not ob.data.materials or ob.data.uv_layers.active is None:continue
  role=next((r for r,m in wood.items() if ob.data.materials[0]==m),None)
  if role is None or ob.data.uv_layers.active.name=='ShipyardPhysicalTimber':continue
  vs=ob.data.vertices;lo=Vector([min(v.co[i] for v in vs) for i in range(3)]);hi=Vector([max(v.co[i] for v in vs) for i in range(3)]);span=hi-lo;axis=max(range(3),key=lambda i:span[i]);cross=[i for i in range(3) if i!=axis];row={'frame':0,'cargo_frame':1,'trim':2,'deck':3}[role];uv=ob.data.uv_layers.active
  for p in ob.data.polygons:
   facecoords=[vs[ob.data.loops[li].vertex_index].co for li in p.loop_indices];end=max(q[axis] for q in facecoords)-min(q[axis] for q in facecoords)<.001
   for li in p.loop_indices:
    q=vs[ob.data.loops[li].vertex_index].co-lo
    if end:u=(3844+min(q[cross[0]],.35)/.36*247)/4096;v=(row*256+4+min(q[cross[1]],.35)/.36*247)/1024
    else:u=(4+(q[axis]+3)/22*3831)/4096;v=(row*256+4+min(q[cross[0]],.35)/.36*247)/1024
    uv.data[li].uv=(u,v)
 # Add header bolts, workbench vise detail and physically fastened coping rings.
 for x in [-1.46,1.46] if which=='A' else [-1.37,1.37]:
  for z in [1.95,3.55]:bolt(which+' reveal fastener',(x,2.02 if which=='A' else -.30,z))
 for x in [-1.75,1.75] if which=='A' else [-3.8,3.8]:
  y=-3.9 if which=='A' else -2.9
  box(which+' mooring plate',(x,y,1.79 if which=='A' else 1.75),(.16,.20,.035),iron,.01)
  ring(which+' mooring eye',(x,y,1.88 if which=='A' else 1.84),.09,iron,'y',.018)
 export(which)
''',ns)
